'''The State of the USA''' is a non-profit group that seeks to present non-partisan data on key national indicators of the United States.<ref name="nyt1">{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/2010/05/16/magazine/16GDP-t.html?pagewanted=all |title=The Rise and Fall of the G.D.P. |work=[[The New York Times]] |date=2010-05-16 |accessdate=2011-01-15}}</ref><ref name="baltsun1">{{cite web|url=http://articles.baltimoresun.com/2010-09-11/business/bs-bz-progress-indicator-20100911_1_gross-national-happiness-genuine-progress-indicator-progress-measurement |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20101003120318/http://articles.baltimoresun.com/2010-09-11/business/bs-bz-progress-indicator-20100911_1_gross-national-happiness-genuine-progress-indicator-progress-measurement |url-status=dead |archive-date=2010-10-03 |title=Genuine Progress Indicator - Putting a dollar figure on progress |work=[[The Baltimore Sun]] |date=2010-09-11 |accessdate=2011-01-15}}</ref><ref name="iowan1">{{cite web|url=http://www.dailyiowan.com/2010/10/21/Metro/19547.html |title=Public Policy Center's guest lecture boosts statistics site |publisher=[[The Daily Iowan]] |date=2010-10-21 |accessdate=2011-01-15}}</ref><ref name="cdc1">{{cite web|url=https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/data_access/chdi.htm |title=Data Access - Community Health Data Initiative - Interim Work Page |publisher=[[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] |date= |accessdate=2011-01-15}}</ref>

The group works with the [[United States National Academy of Sciences]] in creating a federally mandated Key National Indicator System (KNIS).<ref name="nyt1"/><ref name="susa1">{{cite web|url=https://www.stateoftheusa.org/content/work-begins-on-first-official-key-national-indicator-system.php |title=Work Begins on First Official 'Key National Indicator System' |publisher=The State of the USA |date=2010-10-18 |accessdate=2011-01-15}}</ref><ref name="ddd">{{cite web
|url=https://foreignpolicy.com/articles/2011/01/02/gdp_a_brief_history?page=ful
|title=GDP: a brief history
|publisher=[[Foreign Policy]]
|year=2011
|accessdate=2011-01-18
|quote=U.S. government begins funding the State of the USA project, designed to create a "key national indicator system" with hundreds of new data points to add nuance to standard GDP stats.
}}
</ref>
